a.lede: The original Blue Yeti has been one of the most recognizable go-to USB microphones for content creators since it launched in 2009, and now it finally has a successor. Launching today under Logitech G, the Blue Yeti 2 adds some modern upgrades, including an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity based voice sensor […]
a.title: Logitech’s new Blue Yeti 2 mic adjusts itself to where you are

b.lede: After years without a major successor, Logitech’s Yeti 2 arrives with new features designed to simplify microphone setup and audio adjustments.
b.title: Logitech refreshes legendary Blue Yeti microphone with 3D voice tracking and AI denoising
